title: Train a team, price the work and prove your skill

say: Train a team, price the work, and prove your skill.
This is the video for module three of Prompt Engineering.
Teams rarely need a general lecture on AI. They need help with the five or six tasks they do every week.

say: Count all the hours, not just the hours in the room. Discovery 6, preparing templates 8, two days of delivery 10, and follow-up support 4. That is 28 hours.
Her rate is a figure she chose after asking two trainers in her network. It is not a standard.

say: Write both lists in the proposal, with measurable objectives. For example: complaint replies drafted and checked in about 8 minutes each, instead of 15.

panel.heading: In scope and out of scope

say: When the client asks for one more thing, say yes to the value and name the cost, then confirm the change in writing.
Never promise that AI will halve their work or make reports error-free. Promise what you control.

say: Use invoices with your business name, and receive payment into a business account or a recognised service.

panel.heading: Get paid safely

cards.d: Use invoices with your business name and a business account or recognised payment service.
Never share login codes or OTPs with anyone claiming to process a payment for you.
Take part of the fee before discovery starts, and the rest after delivery.
